The three public operations and what each writes to state.

notes: The formsg adaptor (1.0.12) calls no API: FormSG pushes encrypted submissions to a webhook (typically an OpenFn trigger) and decryptSubmission, verifyWebhook and processWebhook verify and decrypt them locally with @opengovsg/formsg-sdk. "Full" is that operation surface: all three ast.json operations are modelled as facade POST paths, with request bodies from the operation arguments and responses equal to the state.data each one writes; FormSGWebhook/EncryptedSubmission model the inbound payload from FormSG's own WebhookData type. Corrected over the July stub: the decrypted output is formsg-sdk DecryptedContent ({responses, verified}, 24 field types), and verifyWebhook returns {verified, signature}; the stub's submissionId/attachments/epoch fields were not what the adaptor returns. Not modelled: FormSG's separate admin/public REST API, which this adaptor has no way to call.
